verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a developer tool for production AI agents, so cost and token dashboards are a fair question for it. However, the evidence only covers trace capture, correction routing, and outcome comparison against holdout groups. Nothing mentions cost, token usage, or per-request, per-model, or per-period dashboards.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards
